propositions: A dedicated Jira DC executor client must be constructed with max_retries=0 and reject any session with nonzero max_retries.

Each write invocation must issue exactly GET, then PUT, then GET (on PUT success) with classified outcomes: retryable/permanent on initial GET fault, commit_unknown on PUT fault, applied only when read-back summary matches intended value.

After an ambiguous PUT outcome, a separate single-attempt GET observation determines recovery (desired state → no replay), conclusive old state (permit remaining-budget replay), or commit_unknown (GET failure/inconclusive).

Completion logs must emit exactly once per terminal or exhausted outcome, containing only logical id, disposition, invocation count, request count, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and one redacted message capped at 512 code points with total serialized size at most 1,024 code points.
